title: spec/facets.json — the semantic tag registry
description: Validates the tag registry that travels inside every werk package. The registry is versioned payload, not a service: a package carries the exact vocabulary its tags were drawn from, so a tag never means something different five years later (law 1, law 2).

tag_pattern.description: Regular expression every canonical tag matches.

free_tag_prefix.description: The namespace a tag outside the registry must use.

cardinality.description: 'one' means a well-formed entity carries at most one tag from this facet; 'many' means several are normal.

aliases.description: alias -> canonical tag. An importer normalises through this map; a canonical tag is never itself an alias key.

deprecated.description: deprecated tag -> replacement, or null when there is none. Deprecated tags stay readable forever; nothing is ever deleted from a registry (law 12).

tag_meta.description: Optional per-tag machine-checkable meaning. Law 8 applies to vocabularies too: where a tag stands for a measurable range, the range is a number here rather than an adjective in someone's head. Used by scale-class, whose tags would otherwise be pure opinion.
